criterion: Given the new semver functions, when dumps_version("1.2.3-rc.1+007") is called, then it returns exactly the string {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"rc.1","build":"007"}; when dumps_version(Version(1, 2, 3)) is called, then it returns exactly {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":null,"build":null}. Both outputs are single-line compact JSON with no whitespace, keys in the order major, minor, patch, prerelease, build, and all five keys always present; the optional fields are the strings "rc.1" and "007" when present and JSON null for a final release.
current_behavior: semver 3.0.4 has no dumps_version; importing it from semver raises ImportError/AttributeError.

sources.quote: dumps_version accepts a Version or a version string accepted by Version.parse.
Emit a compact JSON object in the order major, minor, patch, prerelease, build.
Always emit all five keys.
For 1.2.3-rc.1+007 the optional fields are the strings "rc.1" and "007".
For a final release both optional fields are JSON null.

criterion: Given loads_version, when given the JSON text {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"rc.1","build":"007"}, then it returns a Version with str(result) == "1.2.3-rc.1+007" (the full decoded string including build metadata, not bare Version equality, which ignores build metadata); when given loads_version(dumps_version("3.2.1")), then it returns a Version with str(result) == "3.2.1"; when given {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3} or {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":null,"build":null}, then it returns Version(1, 2, 3) with str "1.2.3"; when given loads_version(dumps_version(Version(9223372036854775808, 2, 3))) (major = 2**63), then it returns a Version with str(result) == "9223372036854775808.2.3" and major exactly 9223372036854775808. This is the manifest round trip: fields in, original version out.
current_behavior: semver 3.0.4 has no loads_version; importing it raises ImportError/AttributeError.

criterion: Given loads_version, when given each of the following inputs, then it raises ValueError: {"major":true,"minor":2,"patch":3} (boolean); {"major":"1","minor":2,"patch":3} (string number); {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":1.5} (fractional); {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":-1} (negative); {"major":1,"patch":3} (missing minor); {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"extra":1} (unknown key); {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"major":2} (duplicate key with all three required fields present, so only the duplicate triggers the error); the malformed text {"major":1, ending early; the non-object inputs [1,2,3], "1.2.3" and 3; {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"rc.01"} (invalid SemVer prerelease); {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"build":"x y"} (invalid SemVer build); {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":""} and {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"build":""} (empty strings, not valid identifier sequences); and {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"prerelease":"rc.1+007"} (plus sign inside a prerelease, which must not be split into prerelease plus build).
current_behavior: semver 3.0.4 has no loads_version; importing it raises ImportError/AttributeError.

sources.quote: The three number fields are required nonnegative JSON integers; booleans, strings and fractional numbers are invalid.
Optional fields may be missing or null, otherwise they must be valid SemVer prerelease/build strings.
Reject unknown or duplicate keys, malformed JSON and non-object inputs with ValueError.
In example 5 use {"major":1,"minor":2,"patch":3,"major":2} for duplicate keys, so a missing field cannot make that test pass accidentally.
Keep the corrected duplicate and full-build controls.

criterion: Given dumps_version, when called with the string "1.2" (which Version.parse rejects), then it raises ValueError; when called with 42 (neither a Version nor a string), then it raises TypeError; and when called with the bytes b"1.2.3", then it raises TypeError, because dumps_version accepts str or Version only, even though Version.parse itself accepts bytes.
current_behavior: semver 3.0.4 has no dumps_version; importing it raises ImportError/AttributeError.

sources.quote: dumps_version accepts a Version or a version string accepted by Version.parse.
Second, dumps_version accepts str or Version only.
bytes such as b'1.2.3' must raise TypeError even though Version.parse itself accepts bytes.

criterion: Given the Version methods: Version.parse("1.2.3").to_json() returns exactly dumps_version("1.2.3"); for any valid JSON text t accepted by loads_version, str(Version.from_json(t)) == str(loads_version(t)), comparing the full decoded string or the individual fields including build (e.g. "1.2.3-rc.1+007"), not bare Version equality; and for every invalid text t listed in AC3, Version.from_json(t) raises the same exception type as loads_version(t).
current_behavior: Version in 3.0.4 has no to_json/from_json attributes; calling them raises AttributeError.

criterion: Given the semver package, when executing from semver import dumps_version, loads_version, then both resolve and are callable; the names "dumps_version" and "loads_version" appear in semver.__all__; and both are importable from the dedicated library module under src/semver/ that defines them (for example via importlib.import_module(semver.dumps_version.__module__)).
current_behavior: semver.__all__ in 3.0.4 contains no dumps_version/loads_version; importing them from the package root raises ImportError.
